scope: shadow research only; repository is public, no private runner archive or third-party dataset uploaded
notes: Coverage arithmetic: Market Rasen 60, Lingfield 22, Thurles 14; total 96. References only, not deduplicated historical records.

Lingfield conditional jockey handicap illustrates provider-specific rating namespaces: RPR is not BHA achieved figure; race weight and claim must not be conflated. https://www.racingpost.com/results/31/lingfield/2026-11-26/931666/
BHA guide explicitly separates race-day handicap mark from achieved performance figure. https://www.britishhorseracing.com/regulation/guide-to-handicapping/
BHA weekly publication timing requires separate known_at and effective_at fields. https://www.britishhorseracing.com/faqs/where-can-i-find-a-horses-new-rating/
